verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows Semgrep CI gating and general 'triage findings' workflows (alerts/tickets) but never documents a severity- or confidence-based filter/gate mechanism (e.g., a --severity flag or confidence field) that lets developers exclude low-value findings from failing builds. Missing for 10: any docs or hands-on evidence of severity/confidence filtering flags, config options, or CI gating rules tied to severity/confidence levels.
